messages:
ava.sales: Quick sync — HeliosHealth (EHR vendor) requested a 10-day pilot next quarter. Scope: SAML 2.0 SSO (SP + IdP tests), SCIM provisioning (bulk import + incremental/patch), RBAC mapping from IdP groups to our role model, and per-tenant domain isolation/verification. They called out HIPAA and want BAA + options for customer-managed keys. Also asked for pilot pricing: ~2M tokens/mo and ~25k active users. Need solutions + security input.
leo.solutions: Thanks. Couple clarifying q's: do they need automated group-based role assignment on first login? Also, will SCIM be bi-directional (user state back to IdP)?
ava.sales: Auto role assignment on first login yes. No need for write-back to IdP — read-only SCIM provisioning is fine.
meera.security: From security: if PHI is in play we should default to Private or Dedicated with strict controls. They asked for HSM-backed KMS, full audit logs (immutable), rotate SAML certs quarterly, and proof of key custody. Also they want SCIM service account with limited scope and IP allowlist.
carmen.product: For the pilot we can offer Dedicated with VPC peering + optional Managed Private for full KMS/HSM. Differences to highlight in the quote: Dedicated = reserved capacity + SAML/SCIM out-of-box; Private = customer-managed keys + on-premise option + longer lead time.
noah.devex: SCIM details: we support schema 2.0 with PATCH for deltas and full replace. For bulk import we accept CSV or NDJSON; example CSV header we send in starter kit: `externalId,email,firstName,lastName,groups,active` and sample row: `ext-123,alice@helios.com,Alice,Nguyen,Clinicians;Admins,true`. We'll provide a mapping config file and a lightweight transform hook for attributes.
leo.solutions: SAML AD/IdP notes: default NameID = `email`, support for `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`, assertion signing and response signing supported. Encrypted assertions only in Private (customer key). We should confirm whether they need SCIM over mTLS.
meera.security: Ask them to confirm mTLS requirement. If they want mTLS, we require cert rotation policy and we'll need to exchange client certs ahead of the POC. Also we require DNS TXT verification for domain ownership per tenant — we should avoid relying on email validation to prevent account takeover.
aiidp-bot: (automated) please attach SAML metadata when available; SAML test SP endpoint: https://sp.redwood.example/saml/test
kai.custsu: I'll pull SOC2 Type II link and BAA template and drop in the shared folder. Also will note any historical pen test summaries.
carmen.product: Pricing note for quote: Hosted pilot (pay-as-you-go) estimate for 2M tokens/mo; Dedicated pilot (1 small GPU pool) with reserved throughput + onboarding hours. Enterprise license includes SSO/SCIM features; professional services for mapping + data import billed separately.
noah.devex: Quick sample SAML metadata for IdP test (small snippet):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.helios.example">
  <IDPSSODescriptor WantAuthnRequestsSigned="false">
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo><X509Data><X509Certificate>MIID...</X509Certificate></X509Data></KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://idp.helios/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
noah.devex: Also adding a small RBAC mapping example we send in the kit: `idp:Clinicians -> redwood:clinician`, `idp:Admin -> redwood:tenant_admin`, fallback = `redwood:read_only`. We recommend a `tenant_owner` claim for billing/admin tasks.
leo.solutions: Operational checklist for POC: 1) exchange SAML metadata, 2) provision SCIM service account + share allowed IPs, 3) upload sample bulk CSV, 4) define RBAC mapping file, 5) verify domain TXT records, 6) run smoke tests (login, provisioning, role enforcement).
meera.security: Small security gotcha to call out in the proposal: ensure SCIM PATCH operations are scoped to only modify attributes we need (avoid email attribute overwrite unless confirmed). Also ensure token lifetimes for SCIM service accounts are limited and rotated.
ava.sales: Great. Action owners: Ava = schedule kickoff + confirm dates; Leo = POC runbook + pricing blurb; Noah = sample CSV + SAML + RBAC examples; Meera = compliance checklist + BAA notes; Kai = SOC2/pen test artifacts. I will intro HeliosHealth and request their SAML metadata and sample CSV.
leo.solutions: I can pair with Noah for the smoke test next Wed afternoon.
meera.security: I'll join the kickoff for key exchange.
kai.custsu: Dropping SOC2 link in #sales-resources and starting BAA draft now.
ava.sales: Intro email sent to HeliosHealth PM — will update thread when I get metadata. :thumbsup:
